name: CupertinoContextMenu
description: An iOS-style context menu that shows a full-screen preview when the user long-presses on the child widget. It can display additional menu actions in a pop-up sheet.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The list of menu actions shown when the context menu is opened.
properties.possible_values: List of CupertinoContextMenuAction or custom widgets.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget that triggers the context menu when long-pressed.

properties.name: previewBuilder
properties.description: An optional builder to customize the preview animation. Provides the build context, animation progress, and the default preview child.

properties.name: enableHapticFeedback
properties.description: Determines whether to trigger haptic feedback when the menu is opened.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
